problem:
n 4 September 2026 I saw a Facebook ad for "ProfitEdge Capital" promising guaranteed 8% weekly returns, claiming to be SECP registered. I contacted their manager "Zain" on WhatsApp, who told me it was 100% safe and that I could withdraw anytime.
Between 8 September and 10 October 2026 I transferred a total of Rs. 2,100,000 by bank transfer in four payments, to three different account titles (ProfitEdge Capital, Ali Enterprises, M. Usman Traders). Their dashboard showed my balance growing to Rs. 3,894,000.
On 18 October 2026 I tried to withdraw. The platform blocked it and demanded a "15% government tax" of Rs. 584,100 first. This was never mentioned before. On 22 October the manager threatened to freeze my account if I did not pay, and then blocked me.
I checked and found no company registration record for ProfitEdge Capital, and the website domain was registered only 24 days before they contacted me. On 23 October I reported the fraud to my bank and got a reference number. I want to recover my money and take legal action. What should I do?

authorities: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
Federal Investigation Agency Cyber Crime Wing
suggestions: File a police FIR immediately attaching all screenshots and bank statements.
Submit a formal complaint to SECP with the ad, dashboard and transaction proof.
Report the case to FIA Cyber Crime Wing for digital investigation.
Ask your bank to trace and possibly reverse the transfers and freeze the recipient accounts.
